pages.title: Cacofey
pages.text: The Cacofey is a mischievous jungle creature, known for stealing food and assisting with farming once tamed. It can also be summoned through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#sacrifice)Nature's Ritual$(/l), which requires a soul sacrifice.

pages.title: Wild Behavior
pages.text: Wild Cacofey are drawn to edible items. They will approach players, steal food, and quickly flee before consuming it. After each attempt, they rest before trying again.

pages.title: Taming
pages.text: Cacofey can be tamed using a Galeberries Cookie. Once tamed, their behavior changes entirely, becoming cooperative rather than mischievous.

pages.title: Anchoring
pages.text: A tamed Cacofey can be bound to a container using a Hex Focus. Once anchored, it treats that location as its home and returns to it after working.

pages.title: Harvesting
pages.text: When set to wander, a tamed Cacofey searches for mature crops, harvests them, and returns to its anchor to deposit the collected items.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: Cacofey can switch between behaviors: following their owner, staying in place, or wandering freely. Wandering is required for farming.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Cacofey provide early automation for farming. With the right setup, they can maintain crops and gather resources while you focus on other tasks.

pages.title: Binding
pages.text: Bind a Cacofey by first attuning a Hex Focus to it, then using the focus on a container. The creature will treat that container as its home.
